subject: RECORD clause
notes: Landed by kb/Work PB1277 (w61f). cite.py --check 13.18.43.4 'the record size includes the entire byte in which that data item ends' -> OK §13.18.43.4 4). BOTH record-size computations now use the §8.5.1.6.3 bit walk: a record of two PIC 1(3) USAGE BIT items is 1 byte at minimum and maximum (was min 2 from a per-leaf re-summation), so RECORD IS VARYING DEPENDING 1 writes (FB1=00) and 2 answers 44; a bit ODO X(1) + PIC 1(3) BIT OCCURS 1 TO 4 is min 2 (11 bits) / max 3 (20 bits). The value of the filler bits is undefined by the rule and not asserted.
